description: KSB Pumps Company Limited is the Pakistani subsidiary of Germany's KSB SE & Co. KGaA, incorporated in 1959 from a joint venture between KSB and BECO and listed as a public company in 1979. It manufactures industrial pumps, valves and castings and provides after-market services, with its head office in Lahore and a production site at Hasanabadal; regional sales offices cover Lahore, Karachi, Multan and Rawalpindi.
sourceNote: Company website (ksb.com/en-pk: about KSB in Pakistan, investor relations) and the PSX company profile (dps.psx.com.pk/company/KSBP: business description, key people, address), read 2026-10-17.
